title: LEFT JOIN
summary: LEFT JOIN keeps every row from the left table even when there is no match on the right (NULLs fill unmatched columns).
objectives: Explain LEFT JOIN in practical web-development terms
Recognize how SQL connects to HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
Apply safe habits and avoid common mistakes

content.code:
SELECT u.email, COUNT(o.id) AS order_count
FROM users u
LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.user_id = u.id
GROUP BY u.id;
